title: Dapagliflozin in the treatment of decompensated liver cirrhosis: phase IIb randomised, controlled clinical trial
official: Dapagliflozin in the treatment of decompensated liver cirrhosis: phase IIb randomised, controlled clinical trial
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of the study will be to evaluate the safety of dapagliflozin versus standard medical therapy in patients with decompensated liver cirrhosis.
conditions: Cirrhosis of liver without mention of alcohol
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age between 18 and 85 years
2. Diagnosis of liver cirrhosis, documented on the basis of histological examination and/or clinical and/or instrumental examinations (ultrasonography, CT scan or liver elastography > 15 kPa)
3. Liver cirrhosis decompensation (overt hepatic encephalopathy, clinically significant ascites, hemorrhage from esophageal varices) developed within the past 12 months
Exclusion criteria:
1. Established hypersensitivity to Dapaglifozin
2. Patient who is a carrier of TIPS
3. Active therapy for HCV eradication with Direct Antiviral Agents or terminated < 6 months before
4. Therapy for HBV suppression with nucleoside/nucleotide analogs started < 6 months before
5. Active alcohol consumption greater than 21 weekly alcohol units
6. Presence of at least one episode of acute kidney injury (AKI) in the 4 weeks prior to enrollment
7. Presence of two or more episodes of urinary tract infection in the 12 months prior to enrollment
8. Presence of >2 episodes of "overt" hepatic encephalopathy in the 12 months prior to enrollment
9. Body mass index (BMI) < 20 kg/m^2
10. History of prior solid organ transplantation
11. Inclusion in other clinical trials in the month prior to study initiation
12. Ongoing therapy with SGLT2 inhibitors (Dapagliflozin, Empagliflozin, Canagliflozin, Ertugliflozin etc)
13. Presence of mental incapacity, complete language barrier, poor social support, or other reasons that, in the opinion of the investigator, may preclude the proper conduct of the study
14. Refusal or inability to sign informed consent and absence of a legal guardian capable of signing consent.
15. Pregnancy or breastfeeding (in the case of women of childbearing age, they will be asked to maintain effective contraception or, alternatively, abstention from sexual intercourse during the observation period)
16. Hepatocarcinoma outside the Milan criteria (a single nodule<5 cm or multiple nodules [maximum 3], the largest of which ≤3 cm)
17. Active extrahepatic malignancy
18. Chronic kidney disease with estimated VFG < 30 ml/min/1.73m2
19. Other known extrahepatic diseases of severe grade (e.g., heart failure NYHA class ≥ 3; COPD GOLD class ≥ 3; psychiatric disorders);
20. Diagnosis oftype 1 Diabetes Mellitus and/or previous history of diabetic ketoacidosis
21. Ascites refractory to diuretic therapy according to International Club of Ascites criteria
